Paragraph: All these different types of sacrifice are approved by the Vedas, and all of them are born of different types of work. Knowing them as such, you will become liberated.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Confusion over which type of work or sacrifice fits one's nature to achieve spiritual freedom.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'All these different types of sacrifice are approved by the Vedas, and all of them are born of different types of work. Knowing them as such, you will become liberated.'
Outcome/Resolution: Understanding that varied forms of action can be elevated into sacrifice frees the seeker from existential bondage.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Self-Awareness in Action: Recognizing how one's physical and mental tendencies drive behaviors
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Channeling Work for Growth: Structuring daily work into a vehicle for personal and mental elevation
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Liberation through Understanding: Relieving cognitive distress by aligning actions with clear, proven principles

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Evam bahu-vidha yajna vitata brahmano mukhe (Multitudinous sacrifices declared in sacred wisdom)
Karma-jan viddhi tan sarvan (Knowing all sacrifices as born of action)
Evam jnatva vimoksyase (Knowing this truth, you will attain liberation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sacrifices manifest through body, mind, or intelligence; realizing their source in action leads to ultimate liberation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Understanding the psychological mechanisms of action enables individuals to channel work into constructive growth.
